keyFindings.description: New fix-5 text binds APPROVED to 'no correctness finding stands' at the first submission, so a clean first pass approves the head that still carries .legion/. Contradicts the same file's mandatory order (single approval at the final head, step 3) and line 57 (no implementation change after approval; the deletion push would follow), and fires the extra pr-review wake fix 5 exists to remove. Fix: REQUEST_CHANGES when a finding stands, otherwise COMMENT while the head carries .legion/; APPROVE only for the deletion head. List COMMENT in the event parenthetical.

Same finding, worker-skill reviewer bullet: 'CHANGES_REQUESTED or APPROVED' leaves no event for a clean pre-deletion pass; same fix, keep the bullet's tail (approve the deletion head by name) as the only APPROVE.

Fix-4 sentence 'the daemon ignores them' is imprecise: every phase schema is .passthrough() (handoff-schema.ts:186-192), so undeclared fields survive parsing and legion handoff read prints them; the real trap is a declared field of the wrong type nulling the whole file. Suggested wording in the thread.
Redrawn skills tree omits skills/envoy/ (tracked at head). Pre-existing omission, but fix 9 redraws the tree; add the envoy/ line between dispatch/ and legion-architect/.

observations: LEGION-12 reproduced in this pane: from ~14:48 every bash call carried 2-3 injected LEGION_GRANT headers; the last export wins and 403s on redeem. Workaround used for the remaining calls: name the first-injected grant of a previous call explicitly (LEGION_GRANT=<id> legion gh ...); such a grant still redeems minutes later.
legion gh -- api --help prints the citty help for `legion gh` instead of gh's: citty intercepts --help even after `--`. Pre-existing CLI bug, not part of this PR.
